policy.existingBindings: All existingIngredientId values remain null pending explicit approval. Candidate IDs are suggestions, not bindings.
policy.identity: Keys distinguish preparation states. Review cultivar, edible portion, grade, formulation and cooking method before acceptance.
policy.units: g is a proposed measured edible mass, not a conversion from piece, volume, purchase weight or another food state.
